source_block.divergence: BORI CE places Vaka-vadha in Ādi ~1.147–1.151 (Debroy Vol. 1). Ganguli’s vulgate English is Vaka-vadha Parva Sections CLVII–CLXVI. Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same Bakāsuravadha arc under its Ādi adhyāya numbering. The beats agree: Pandavas live incognito in a brāhmaṇa’s house at Ekacakrā; Vaka’s due is a cart of food plus one human; the lot falls on their host; Kunti sends Bhīma; Bhīma eats the food and kills Vaka; the town is freed.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap: the Vaka-vadha itself as told in both. Debroy Vol. 1 translates BORI Ādi ~1.147–1.151. Ganguli CLVII–CLXVI for English beat map.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology Bakasura (no gore). Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs.
